scripts.dev: npm run build -w @fair-rps/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,web "npm run dev -w @fair-rps/shared" "npm run dev -w @fair-rps/server" "npm run dev -w @fair-rps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @fair-rps/shared && npm run build -w @fair-rps/server && npm run build -w @fair-rps/web
scripts.e2e: npm run build && playwright test -c e2e/playwright.config.ts
